report_name: AI-Powered Espionage Campaign Uses Custom Malware on Linux Systems

threat_actors.name: CL-UNK-1211
threat_actors.description: A sophisticated threat actor responsible for an espionage campaign active from October 2025 to April 2026, targeting government and state-affiliated Linux infrastructure. The actor is notable for using AI-generated payloads, including custom backdoors and web shells, for intelligence gathering, credential theft, and data exfiltration.
threat_actors.goals: The primary objectives were intelligence gathering, exfiltrating entire databases, and compromising social media accounts linked to government email mailboxes.

attack_patterns.name: Server Software Component: Web Shell
attack_patterns.description: The primary vector for access and persistence was the deployment of custom and publicly available PHP web shells on compromised Linux servers.

attack_patterns.name: Hijack Execution Flow
attack_patterns.description: Modified the 'auto_prepend_file' directive in PHP configuration files to force a malicious script to load before any legitimate PHP script, ensuring persistence of their web shells.

attack_patterns.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell
attack_patterns.description: Relied heavily on shell scripts for execution of malicious commands and payloads on the compromised Linux systems.

attack_patterns.name: Unix Shell Configuration Modification
attack_patterns.description: Modified the .bashrc file to create a malicious alias for the 'sudo' command, which was used to trigger a password-stealing script.

attack_patterns.name: Input Capture: Keylogging
attack_patterns.description: Captured user passwords by aliasing the 'sudo' command to a script that logged the entered password to a file before passing it to the legitimate sudo command.

attack_patterns.name: Masquerading: Match Legitimate Name or Location
attack_patterns.description: Attempted to blend in with normal system activity by naming their password log file 'Solarwinds.StatusLog.txt' and a web shell 'plesk_sys_driver.php'.

attack_patterns.name: Indicator Removal: File Deletion
attack_patterns.description: Attempted to erase system logs to cover their tracks and hinder forensic investigation.

attack_patterns.name: Email Collection
attack_patterns.description: Performed extensive reconnaissance by enumerating mailboxes on compromised systems.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Local System
attack_patterns.description: Collected data by dumping the entire contents of databases on compromised servers.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Attempted to exfiltrate collected data from the compromised network using their established backdoors.

attack_patterns.name: Obtain Capabilities: Artificial Intelligence
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor used what appears to be AI-assisted code generation, leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate attack tools such as PHP and shell scripts.

malware.name: Custom PHP Web Shell
malware.description: A custom PHP web shell, named 'plesk_sys_driver.php', was deployed for initial access and persistence on government Linux servers. The actor also used publicly available web shells from GitHub.

malware.name: Custom Credential Theft Script
malware.description: A custom script, executed via a malicious 'sudo' alias in .bashrc, designed to capture user passwords as they were typed and save them to a log file named 'Solarwinds.StatusLog.txt'.

malware.name: Custom Backdoor
malware.description: Custom AI-generated backdoors were used by the CL-UNK-1211 actor for long-term access and data exfiltration from compromised Linux systems.

campaigns.name: CL-UNK-1211 Campaign
campaigns.description: An AI-powered espionage campaign active from October 2025 to April 2026, targeting government and state-affiliated Linux infrastructure with custom malware for intelligence gathering.

identities.name: Government and State-Affiliated Organizations
identities.description: The primary targets of the CL-UNK-1211 espionage campaign, whose Linux infrastructure was compromised for intelligence gathering purposes.

indicators.name: CL-UNK-1211 Masquerading File Names
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: CL-UNK-1211 Masquerading File Creation
id: 7c5b1a3d-8e4f-4b2a-9c1d-0f8a7b6c5d4e
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of files with names used by the CL-UNK-1211 actor to masquerade their tools.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-16
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/ai-campaign-targets-linux-infrastructure/
tags:
  - attack.t1036.005
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '/plesk_sys_driver.php'
      - '/Solarwinds.StatusLog.txt'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of files with names used by the CL-UNK-1211 actor to masquerade their web shell and password log file.

indicators.name: CL-UNK-1211 Sudo Hijacking via .bashrc
indicators.pattern:
title: CL-UNK-1211 Sudo Hijacking via .bashrc Modification
id: 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects modification of .bashrc files to include a malicious 'sudo' alias, a technique used by CL-UNK-1211 for password theft.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-16
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/ai-campaign-targets-linux-infrastructure/
tags:
  - attack.t1546.004
  - attack.t1056.001
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_filename:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '/.bashrc'
  selection_content:
    Contents|contains: 'alias sudo='
  condition: all of selection_*

indicators.name: CL-UNK-1211 PHP auto_prepend_file Persistence
indicators.pattern:
title: CL-UNK-1211 PHP auto_prepend_file Persistence
id: f0e9d8c7-b6a5-4f3e-2d1c-0b9a8e7d6c5b
status: experimental
description: Detects modifications to PHP configuration files to set the 'auto_prepend_file' directive, a persistence technique used by CL-UNK-1211.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-16
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/ai-campaign-targets-linux-infrastructure/
tags:
  - attack.t1574
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '/etc/php/'
      - '/opt/plesk/php/'
  selection_content:
    Contents|contains: 'auto_prepend_file'
  condition: all of selection_*

indicators.name: Suspicious Shell from PHP Process
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Shell Spawned from PHP-FPM
id: c4b3a2d1-e0f9-4e8d-7c6b-5a4b3c2d1e0f
status: experimental
description: Detects a PHP-FPM process spawning a shell, which could indicate web shell execution as seen in the CL-UNK-1211 campaign.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-16
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/ai-campaign-targets-linux-infrastructure/
tags:
  - attack.t1505.003
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '/php-fpm'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/zsh'
      - '/csh'
      - '/ksh'
  condition: all of selection_*
